## Body

PR 343 @59db7f9 block (adb0b79e). Runner itself clean: spawnSync with no shell, inputs only through env, recipe names read from the justfile. The risk sat in a procedure script: relaunch.sh built tmux respawn-pane 'env $envs ...' from ps -E values, putting env values in argv (ps, EDR) and inside an unquoted sh -c string, against req-13. Grep procedure scripts for respawn-pane, sh -c and value interpolation, not just the runner. Second lesson: a JSON object keyed by user input (--key __proto__) loses the record and pollutes the prototype; check for Object.hasOwn or a key regex. Mutation recipe that worked: git archive HEAD | tar -x into mktemp, symlink the main checkout's node_modules, git init, perl -0pi each guard, run vitest at nice 19, restore from a saved copy. The before-run done check (=== 0 to !== 1) mutant survived: say so when a test gap exists even though the code is right.
